owner_scope.source: FastAPI validated JWT sub; worker uses server-only HONOR_OWNER_USER_ID
owner_scope.other_table_policy: honor_owner_authorized() where helper SELECTs owner_profiles under the direct owner_profiles policy
transaction_sequence: set_config(..., true) using validated owner UUID
owner context disappears before pooled connection reuse

reused_connection_test.transaction_a: set owner UUID transaction-locally and verify authorized SELECT succeeds
reused_connection_test.after_commit: current_setting('honor.owner_user_id', true) is NULL or empty
reused_connection_test.transaction_b_before_set: authorization helper returns false; no owner row is visible
reused_connection_test.result: PASS only if identity from transaction A is absent

terminal_insert_rules.qc_runs: insert only after a QC attempt reaches terminal success/failure; finished_at and passed are non-null; retry creates a new row
terminal_insert_rules.render_manifests: insert only after a successful immutable QC result; one accepted terminal manifest per clip

special_insert_rules.campaign_rule_items: immutable normalized facts scoped to campaign_terms_snapshots.id; no UPDATE/DELETE
special_insert_rules.run_campaign_allocations: immutable committed decision evidence with exact rule/rights/account-health/run/as-of/version inputs
special_insert_rules.candidates: committed candidate identity/scoring/transcript lineage is insert-only

C_ADMIN_MAINTAINED.audio_assets_admin_rule: audio_assets material identity/provenance/allowed-use fields are immutable after INSERT. Admin may only revoke future use via one-way active TRUE->FALSE; DELETE and false->true reactivation are forbidden. Changed binary/license/rights requires a new asset id/version.

D_COST_LEDGER_CONSTRAINED.update_rule: Only actual_cost_usd/reconciled_at may change, only NULL->non-NULL once, in one transaction that inserts an audit_log row; all other UPDATE and every DELETE are rejected by trigger.

E_FUNCTION_COMMITTED_RIGHTS.mutation_path: honor_commit_source_rights_version(...) only; inserts a new rights row and complete campaign applicability set atomically; no later association to an existing rights version

F_EARNINGS_CONSTRAINED.update_rule: Direct honor_app UPDATE is revoked. honor_transition_earning(...) locks the row, validates the frozen graph, inserts earning_state_transitions with exact from_state/to_state/amount snapshot, then updates state/last_state_at atomically.

G_FUNCTION_COMMITTED_EARNING_TRANSITIONS.mutation_path: honor_transition_earning(...) only; inserts immutable transition and updates earnings.state/last_state_at atomically in the same transaction

H_FUNCTION_COMMITTED_RULE_SEALS.description: Immutable rule-set seal records. honor_app may SELECT; INSERT only through owner-authorized seal function; no UPDATE/DELETE.

I_ACCEPTED_SIGNATURE_RESERVATIONS.runtime: INSERT only through clip READY acceptance trigger; SELECT allowed; UPDATE/DELETE forbidden
I_ACCEPTED_SIGNATURE_RESERVATIONS.mutation_path: honor_final_uniqueness_acceptance_guard() only via clip READY transition

special_rules.cost_ledger: Insert is permanent. Only one-time NULL->value reconciliation of actual_cost_usd/reconciled_at is permitted, and it MUST insert audit_log in the same transaction; all other UPDATE/DELETE denied.
special_rules.earnings: Initial ACCRUED_UNVERIFIED insertion is direct runtime INSERT; direct runtime UPDATE is revoked. Every state change uses honor_transition_earning(...) to lock the row, validate the graph, insert the immutable transition with exact pre-state/to-state/amount snapshot, and update state/last_state_at atomically.
special_rules.delete_policy: No runtime DELETE grant or RLS DELETE policy on any HONOR table
special_rules.source_rights: Immutable/versioned and runtime SELECT-only. New evidence, revocation, or applicability requires a new contiguous source_rights version created through honor_commit_source_rights_version(...); historical rows never UPDATE/DELETE.
special_rules.source_rights_campaigns: Immutable relationship history and runtime SELECT-only. The complete applicability set is inserted only inside honor_commit_source_rights_version(...) with the new rights version; later attachment to an existing rights version is impossible for honor_app.
special_rules.edit_plans: insert-only committed plans; revisions create incremented plan_version with supersedes_edit_plan_id
special_rules.audio_plans: insert-only committed plans; revisions create incremented plan_version with supersedes_audio_plan_id
special_rules.qc_runs: terminal-at-insert, finished_at/passed required, append-only; each retry is a new row
special_rules.render_manifests: terminal immutable record inserted only when honor_render_manifest_guard verifies passed terminal QC and clip-matching edit/audio plan; one per clip
special_rules.ready_gate: clip may enter READY only when honor_clip_ready_guard finds a render_manifest linked to passed qc_run matching the clip edit/audio plan references
special_rules.source_rights_version_chain: rights v1 has no predecessor; N>1 must supersede exactly N-1 for the same source_id; UNIQUE(supersedes_rights_id) prevents forks
special_rules.edit_plan_version_chain: plan v1 has no predecessor; N>1 must supersede exactly N-1 for the same candidate_id; UNIQUE(supersedes_edit_plan_id) prevents forks
special_rules.audio_plan_version_chain: plan v1 has no predecessor; N>1 must supersede exactly N-1 for the same edit_plan_id; UNIQUE(supersedes_audio_plan_id) prevents forks
special_rules.clip_cross_record_integrity: composite FKs + honor_clip_cross_record_guard enforce rights/source/campaign, rule/campaign, candidate/source/run, edit-plan JSON provenance, audio/edit-plan, posting account/identity, and native-audio rule snapshot consistency
special_rules.clip_provenance_lock: after accepted render_manifest exists or clip state is READY/POSTED/ARCHIVED, generation/campaign/source/account/edit/audio/rule/rights/output identity fields are immutable; corrections create new lineage
special_rules.posting_snapshot: posting_recommendation is canonical; caption_copy/title_copy/hashtags are atomically derived mirrors; recommendation locks at POSTED/ARCHIVED or first posts row
special_rules.rights_expiration: source_rights.expires_at is sole authority; expired at T iff expires_at non-null and T >= expires_at; no duplicate expiration in authorized_uses
special_rules.campaign_terms_lineage: campaigns current snapshot and campaign_rule_items evidence snapshot use composite same-campaign foreign keys
special_rules.post_lineage: post account equals clip account; platform equals social account and posting recommendation; native_audio_used platform equals post; INSERT requires READY and atomically advances clip to POSTED
special_rules.submission_lineage: submission campaign equals campaign of post.clip
special_rules.analytics_checkin_lineage: nullable observation checkin_id uses composite (checkin_id,post_id) FK to same post
special_rules.earning_lineage: earning optional post campaign and evidence snapshot campaign must equal earning campaign
special_rules.earning_transition_atomicity: Direct earnings UPDATE and direct earning_state_transitions INSERT are revoked; honor_transition_earning(...) locks the earning, validates the frozen state graph, inserts the immutable transition with exact pre-state/to-state/amount snapshot, and updates earnings.state/last_state_at in one transaction. Any failure rolls the transaction back.
special_rules.source_rights_campaign_commit: complete campaign applicability is inserted only with a new rights version through honor_commit_source_rights_version; historical rights cannot receive later runtime associations
special_rules.authorized_use_matrix: HONOR_RIGHTS_STAGE_MATRIX.json + honor_rights_stage_allowed define required flags; UNKNOWN/false never grants; campaign clips additionally require commercial_use and derivative_edits
special_rules.recommended_publish_time: non-null recommendation must be before rights expires_at/end/deadline, not before start, and timing rules for frozen snapshot cannot be UNKNOWN/absent
special_rules.native_audio_authority: committed audio plan recommendation is planning authority and posting recommendation is exact mirror; RECOMMENDED requires audio plan; prohibited/unknown rule states cannot escalate
special_rules.campaign_rule_snapshots: campaign_terms_snapshots.id identifies immutable normalized evidence/rule snapshots; campaign_rule_items are append-only before seal and append-closed after campaign_rule_set_commits; current campaign mirrors advance only through honor_activate_campaign_rule_snapshot() on a newer sealed snapshot.
special_rules.campaign_truth_model: KNOWN requires typed value/evidence/verified_at; NOT_APPLICABLE requires null value/evidence/verified_at; UNKNOWN requires null typed value
special_rules.campaign_rule_registry: HONOR_CAMPAIGN_RULE_REGISTRY.json exactly defines 32 keys and per-key typed schemas/consumers; UNKNOWN critical rules block relevant stage
special_rules.account_eligibility: account_health_snapshots region/follower_count/posting_available are nullable facts; missing required fact => UNKNOWN/BLOCKED, never guessed
special_rules.rights_action_time: honor_current_rights_for_action() selects latest source rights version available at T before checking campaign/stage; no fallback to older rights after a newer narrowing/revocation.
special_rules.transcript_candidate_lineage: candidate pins SUCCEEDED same-source transcript_id; candidate insert-only; transcript retry creates new version row
special_rules.generation_decision_history: run creation inputs immutable; selected_plan write-once; allocations insert-only with exact rule/rights/account snapshot/as-of/version inputs
special_rules.lifecycle_guards: creation/transition guards enforce earnings/posts/checkins/submissions/clips/sources/jobs/generation_runs state contracts independent of caller-supplied enum values
special_rules.experiment_tracking: minimal experiments/arms/assignments; assignment identity immutable, exposed_at one-time; causal claims require experiment evidence
special_rules.analytics_learning_fields: watch_time_ms=total cumulative; average_watch_duration_ms/completed_views/completion_rate_ppm/follower_delta nullable UNKNOWN when unavailable
special_rules.rights_attribution_duration: required_attribution must be explicit in posting snapshot+caption; effective duration obeys most restrictive known campaign and rights max; UNKNOWN critical restriction blocks media/READY
special_rules.native_audio_platform: posting nested native recommendation platform, posting platform, account platform, and committed audio-plan native platform are identical
special_rules.campaign_rule_history: campaign_rule_items are insert-only and snapshot-scoped by terms_snapshot_id; activation requires exactly 32 canonical keys and updates current campaign mirrors atomically. Historical decisions pin rule_snapshot_id.
special_rules.campaign_scalar_mirrors: provider/campaign_url/external_campaign_id/status/start_at/end_at/deadline_at/last_verified_at are current mirrors and are not direct runtime UPDATE columns; honor_activate_campaign_rule_snapshot() is the mutation path.
special_rules.transcript_lineage: paid transcript rows pin campaign_id+rights_id and are authorized at created_at; terminal attempts are immutable once consumed and retry creates contiguous new transcript version.
special_rules.candidate_history: candidates are append-only and pin exact successful transcript_id plus scoring/features/version; old scoring is never rewritten.
special_rules.allocation_history: run_campaign_allocations are append-only and pin exact rule snapshot, rights version, account-health snapshot, decision time and model/rules versions.
special_rules.experiment_history: minimal experiment assignments pin arm+unit+time; identity is immutable and exposed assignment cannot change; experiment lifecycle is guarded.
special_rules.campaign_cross_rule_invariants: honor_activate_campaign_rule_snapshot rejects KNOWN min/max clip inversion, start/end inversion, remaining_budget > total_budget, and min_followers > max_followers.
special_rules.audio_plan_current_rights: honor_audio_plan_version_guard revalidates the edit plan pinned rights against the latest rights as of audio-plan committed_at and blocks UNKNOWN render/native-audio rules.
special_rules.future_posting_recommendation: Owner-facing schedule/recommendation queries revalidate the stored clip rights against the latest PUBLICATION_RECOMMENDATION rights at response time; obsolete broader rights are never fallback authorization.
special_rules.campaign_rule_set_seals: campaign_rule_set_commits is runtime SELECT-only; owner-authorized SECURITY DEFINER honor_seal_campaign_rule_set(...) is the sole runtime insert path; seal rows are immutable and close the underlying campaign_rule_items tuple to later inserts.
special_rules.internal_action_time: Internal authorization timestamps are overwritten by DB statement time on protected insert/transition paths; external factual capture/published/observed times remain factual inputs.
special_rules.experiment_predeclaration: Experiment design may mutate only while remaining DRAFT; DRAFT->RUNNING requires >=2 arms exactly one control; no arm mutation afterward; assignments only RUNNING with exact experiment unit_type and DB-authored assignment/exposure times.
special_rules.round9_qc_truth: qc_runs.passed is derived by honor_qc_truth_guard from HONOR_QC_POLICY; caller hard_gate cannot downgrade canonical policy.
special_rules.round9_recommendation_revision: material pre-post recommendation revisions are DB-timestamped/versioned and reauthorize current publication rights/current sealed campaign rule snapshot.
special_rules.round9_experiment_serialization: arm and assignment mutation lock parent experiment row FOR UPDATE before status checks.
special_rules.restriction_proof_lineage: restriction_proof_artifacts is append-only immutable evidence; edit/post restriction compliance must resolve to a matching proof row. OWNER_REVIEW additionally requires a matching RESOLVED owner_actions record.
special_rules.restriction_rule_key_placement: Seal rejects any restriction code outside its canonical source/content/editing/uniqueness rule key and rejects duplicate semantic codes.
special_rules.null_audio_plan_render: clip.audio_plan_id NULL requires null manifest audio identity and empty render_safe_assets; render-audio QC N/A is permitted only for NOT_APPLICABLE render_audio_rules.
special_rules.experiment_arm_identity: experiment_arms.id/experiment_id/created_at immutable; UPDATE/DELETE serialize against OLD parent experiment row.
special_rules.audio_assets: Runtime role is SELECT-only. Immutable asset versions freeze storage key, SHA-256, kind, license identity/reference/evidence hash, provenance, render_safe, attribution requirement and allowed_uses. active may transition TRUE->FALSE only. Exact V1 automatic eligibility is checked at audio-plan commit, render start and render-manifest admission.
special_rules.owner_actions: Creation is OPEN only with DB-authored requested_at/created_at. OPEN may transition once to RESOLVED or CANCELLED with DB-authored terminal time and canonical resolution hash. Terminal actions are immutable and cannot reopen. Restriction-compliance OWNER_REVIEW is PRECOMMIT: resolution may bind a reserved future target UUID but must match exact campaign/sealed-rule/candidate/restriction/target_type/target_version/subject hash, and later consumption must match the actual committed target and chronology.

sequence_privileges.reason: V1 application tables use UUID identifiers and no sequence-backed runtime insert columns.

honor_app_execute_only: honor_commit_source_rights_version(uuid, uuid, integer, uuid, source_eligibility_enum, jsonb, jsonb, text, text, text, timestamptz, timestamptz, text, text, uuid[])
honor_transition_earning(uuid, earning_state_enum, timestamptz, text, text, text, text)
function_privileges.rule: Every HONOR-created function explicitly revokes PUBLIC. Trigger/RLS helpers and the two narrowly-scoped SECURITY DEFINER transaction functions are exact honor_app allowlist entries; direct table privileges remain least-privilege.
